statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains at the lower WATCH boundary as Nasdaq-100 futures are lower alongside 5%+ Treasury yields and roughly $108 oil, while current public evidence does not verify a persistent one-way NQ path.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Cross-asset Stress remains extreme; a higher Tail state would require observed directional efficiency, shallow pullbacks, repeated failed retracements, session-extreme holding or another current amplifier.
headline: Tail remains at WATCH amid 5% yields, $108 oil and softer Nasdaq futures
body: Reuters reported Nasdaq-100 e-minis down about 0.58%, the U.S. 10-year near 5.03% and Brent around $108. A later Reuters analysis described broad equity resilience rather than panic. The aligned backdrop supports extreme Stress, but persistent no-retracement NQ structure is not verified.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 UTC clock hours, Tail eased from elevated event/whipsaw readings during Monday into low overnight, then returned to WATCH as the yield, oil and technology backdrop strengthened. The latest published 09:00 UTC assessment was 20% Tail with 96% Stress.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 20% WATCH because rates, oil and softer Nasdaq futures are aligned, while persistent one-way NQ structure remains unverified. Conditional Tail peaks at 24% around the 12:30 UTC Empire State release and 13:30 UTC cash open, then falls if meaningful retracement and two-way price discovery remain available.

forecast.analysis: Published evidence shows Nasdaq-100 e-minis about 0.58% lower, the U.S. 10-year near 5.03% and Brent near $108, while broader equities still show no panic. Current public evidence does not verify a persistent no-retracement NQ path.
